title: Google Patents
description: Documented public historical patent archive (Google) for the Historical Invention Miner capability area.
body:
Google Patents is a documented historical patent archive from Google. Full-text archive of 120M+ patent documents reaching back to the 1700s, making forgotten and expired inventions searchable for modern re-evaluation.

How it works: It works by tokenizing the query and each document, computing Jaccard similarity over term sets, and ranking the archive so the closest prior art surfaces first.

Documented uses of this capability area include corporate innovation programs, patent landscaping for R&D strategy, open-innovation challenges, and systematic inventive-problem-solving training.
